AE.source: Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships, Article 51 (in force from 2 February 2022, Article 74): 21 days' basic wage for each of the first five years and 30 days for each year after, for a foreign worker with a year or more of continuous service; parts of a year in proportion; unpaid days of absence left out; at most two years' wage; nationals under the pensions law instead. Read from the English text at https://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/uae217212E.pdf, which says it is not an official translation; the Arabic text governs. A day's wage is taken as a thirtieth of the monthly wage.

SA.source: Labor Law, Royal Decree No. M/51 of 23/8/1426 H (27 September 2005), Article 84: half a month's wage for each of the first five years and a month's wage for each year after, on the last wage (Article 2: the actual wage, basic plus allowances), parts of a year in proportion. Article 85: on resignation a third after two to five years, two thirds after more than five and under ten, the whole after ten or more. Read from the English translation at https://www.wipo.int/wipolex/en/text/498399, which is for guidance only; the Arabic text governs. Not checked against the amendments of Royal Decree M/44 of 1446 H.
